verdict.rationale: The evidence clearly shows llama.cpp running several LLMs (Qwen, LLaMA 7B/30B/70B, Gemma-3) and multimodal vision models via `llama cli` and llama-mtmd-cli. Community users confirm the vision support works well. Nothing in the pack shows breadth on the scale of hundreds of architectures, or support for MoE or embedding models. missing for 10: evidence of MoE model support, evidence of embedding model support, documentation of the breadth of supported architectures (hundreds).
